scope: Mac simulation only; no ROSMASTER motion
cause: The cycle trained another fresh ACT after each failed validation without a paired gate against the previous model.
Several teacher demonstrations failed to retain cloth during lift or release it inside the basket.
changes: Paired ten-scene diagnostic model comparison retains the reference on tie or loss.
One verified corrective teacher round is allowed after a loss; another loss requires diagnosis and stops repetition.
New ACT training can start from the reference weights while preserving its normalization and nonoverlapping train/validation scene split.
The teacher plans grasp and open-finger release in isolated MuJoCo state; actual episodes still decide success.

maintenance_transition_fix.cause: Installer used the operator cancel endpoint after training completed, then treated its own stop as an operator pause.
maintenance_transition_fix.fix: Authenticated maintenance stop returns an ownership token. The cycle records maintenance separately; the installer verifies that token before installing. Operator stops and active training block maintenance.
maintenance_transition_fix.tests: 39 targeted tests passed on the final source correction.
maintenance_transition_fix.deployment: Source correction only. Existing operator-labelled pause is preserved; current cycle was not resumed. Legacy services without the maintenance endpoint are rejected before cancellation.

limitations: These paired teacher trials do not qualify the learned ACT policy.
Some high-basket releases still fail; a deeper unhook trial did not improve the targeted case and was not selected.
The current ACT job must finish before maintenance installs new cycle logic in the local simulator.
Physical robot execution still needs independent simulation qualification and hardware acceptance.
